$comment: The committed registry of every account-level screen this project screenshots. A step is DATA, never code: run.mjs reads every *.json in journey/steps/ in alphabetical file order and concatenates their steps arrays. A record carrying an unknown field, an out-of-set enumerated value (requirement, session, reset, action kind), a duplicate id, an id not matching ^[a-z0-9-]+$, a missing rubric file, or a settleMs that is not a non-negative integer is REJECTED as STEPS INVALID rather than ignored — an ignored record is a screen nobody screenshots and nobody notices. Gate G16 (plan 11-08) reads this file statically. Sibling files: org.json (plan 11-06), intake.json (plan 11-07).
